title: person-profile — case shape (v0.2)
description: Pins the MYY5 person-private AI profile codec (encode/decode_person_profile_blob_raw) over the AAD aad_person_profile_blob (role 'person-profile-blob', account_number_hash || profile_id, v0.2 prefix). The key is the person's phrase-derived profile KEK; the id and account hash are AAD-bound, so a blob moved to another person or vault fails to open (myne-md/myne#712, decisions/protocol/0594).
